# QnALog 1.6.3

## Highlights

- Text that contains `$&`, `$$`, `` $` `` or `$'` is now saved exactly as written in minutes. This covers merged-note source titles and metadata, the merge confirmation dialog, continuation recording info, archived live outlines, merge-retry bodies, and version titles and bodies. Before, those sequences could be rewritten or could truncate text after them.
- Sediment panel: the undo button on the commit toast now reads "Undo" (撤销). It previously showed an unrelated AI-service message.
- Sediment panel: a scan that was cancelled or replaced no longer resets the "scanning" state of the newer scan on the same note, and no longer marks the newer scan as cancelled in the task center.
- Removing empty short recordings no longer fails after the files were already moved to the trash when the task queue is unavailable.
- The paused-recovery dialog uses theme text colors and wraps long paths.

## User impact

This release does not change the settings schema or API key storage. Existing provider settings and keys remain in place. No existing feature is removed. Most of the other changes are internal: the sediment, note-writing, queue-recovery and recording code moved into modules with stricter type checking, with the same outputs on the project's regression fixtures.
